headline: Egyptian Gold Prices Drop 8.4% in One Week Following Global Sell-Off
summary: Gold prices in Egypt declined by EGP 500 over the past week, with 21-karat gold falling over 8.4%. The drop follows a sharp decline in international precious metal prices.
why: Gold is a primary hedge against inflation and currency devaluation in emerging markets like Egypt. Local prices track both international spot bullion and domestic exchange rates.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Sharp drop in global bullion prices drove local 21-karat gold down by over 8.4%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global bullion losses reduced domestic gold valuations in Egyptian markets.
